Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us from this game. We hope you enjoyed our coverage. India would be delighted with a complete performance. Pakistan have a lot of soul searching to do. The tournament goes on with Australia locking horns with Bangladesh tomorrow at The Oval. Action begins at 1330 local time (1230 GMT). Until then, it's goodbye and take care.

India skipper, Virat Kohli says that they were superb with the bat and the ball but poor in the field. Adds that they took the confidence from winning the warm-up games into the main tournament. Once again mentions that they were clinical with their skills but poor in the field. Informs that opening partnership was the key for them last time around in the Champions Trophy and Shikhar Dhawan continued his form while Rohit Sharma took his time out in the middle. He adds that Rohit needed those runs in his bag. Credits Yuvraj Singh for playing a sublime knock in the middle and taking the pressure off him and says that he's a game-changer. Also applauds Hardik Pandya's cameo in the end. Ends by stating that because they were playing Pakistan, they went in with an extra seamer and it will depend on the opposition going forward.

Pakistan skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed feels that they were not upto the mark in the field. Rues the fact that they lost the plot in the last eight overs with the ball. Credits India for playing well and taking the game away. Hopes that they get together and plan things better with both bat and ball.

Man of the Match, Yuvraj Singh calls it a good start to the tournament by getting some runs on the board. Adds that the openers gave them a good platform, Virat Kohli finished it well and he got the license to attack today. Informs that it's not easy to come back from an injury but one has to get out there and announce to the opposition that he is here to attack. Mentions that the bowlers bowled well today and they stuck to their plans. Ends by saying that they would like to carry this confidence into the Sri Lanka game.

Umesh Yadav was the best bowler for India, taking 3 for 30. Hardik Pandya and Ravindra Jadeja chipped in with a couple of wickets each. India didn't field that well and it will be something they would want to better going ahead. The rain did threaten to play spoilsport but in the end, we had enough time for a result. A lot was expected from this contest but as has been the case in the last few years, it was another one-sided game.

India have wrapped the game in fine fashion here. They had done most of the damage with the bat itself when they posted a par score on the board. It was thanks to the fifties from their top order batsmen that they got to that total despite the rain hampering their progress. The bowlers then backed up the good work. Azhar Ali was the lone man fighting for Pakistan in the chase with a fifty but he did not get any help from the rest as they kept losing wickets at intervals.

OUT! 3-fer for Umesh Yadav! A touch behind length and angling in. It's too quick for the tailender Hasan Ali, who ends up checking his shot straight to Dhawan at mid-wicket. All the players are shaking hands as WAHAB RIAZ, who was injured in the first innings won't come out to bat. INDIA WIN BY 124 RUNS (DLS METHOD).
Back of a length outside off, placed to point.
Hasan Ali is the new man in.

OUT! Soft dismissal! Back of a length, angling away, Amir backs away a touch and looks to jab it over covers but gets it off the higher part of the bat. The ball goes straight to Jadhav at cover, who doesn't make a mistake this time.
On a length, around off, played uppishly over mid-wicket for a couple.
Powerplay 3 is signaled. Five fielders are now allowed outside the circle.
On the pads, tucked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Full outside off, pushed to mid off.

NOT OUT! On a length and angling in, Khan looks to play a pull but gets a top edge. The ball goes to fine leg and the batsmen run for a single. Yadav there scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. The umpire goes upstairs but Khan is safely in.
There is a run out appeal at the bowler's end. Shadab Khan is the man in question.
Back of a length delivery, flat-batted to mid on.
Pitched on a length outside off, nips away slightly. Khan is beaten all ends up by that movement.
Length delivery, angling in, Amir taps it on the off side and takes off for a quick single. There's a shy at the bowler's end but it misses.
Jasprit Bumrah comes back on for a bowl.
Short delivery, Shadab mistimes his pull towards mid on. Amir takes off from the non-striker's end but is sent back. Pandya scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but Amir is safely in.
Around leg, worked fine down the leg side for a single.
Wide! Short but down the leg side. A wide is signaled.
A touch ahead of length outside off, angling away. Amir throws his bat at it, gets an outside edge and the ball runs towards third man. A couple is taken.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Dropped a sitter! Shortish delivery outside off, angling in, Shadab goes for an expansive pull but gets a top edge. It's straight to Jadhav at covers, who gets underneath it, keeps himself composed but lets it go through. This is poor from India. A single is taken.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched to covers.
Umesh Yadav returns for a bowl.
Missed by just! Amir makes room, Jadeja darts it in, following him. Amir throws his bat at it but misses.
Served outside off, dabbed towards short third man.
Fired in, defended from within the crease.
Flatter and shorter outside off, chopped to point.
Full on off, eased down to long off for a single.
Jadeja comes from over the wicket, pitches it outside off, spinning in, driven to long off for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Amir slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
Shorter in length on middle and leg, Amir ducks under it.
Good length on the stumps, Amir looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Mohammed Amir is the new man in.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Angles in a good length delivery just outside off, Sarfraz looks to dab to third man but only manages to get an outside edge which is snaffled by Dhoni behind the wickets. The writing is on the wall now for Pakistan.
FOUR! Too good! Fuller in line of the stumps, Ahmed pushes it back down the wicket. Umesh from mid on goes to his right but cannot stop the ball from going through. A boundary results.
Fuller outside off, Ahmed drives it towards mid off.
WIDE! Slants it down the leg side on a length. Ahmed gets out of the way. Signaled a wide.

FOUR! Just wide of Jadhav! Slider from Jadeja, Khan goes back and punches it uppishly past Jadhav at mid-wicket. Gets it in the huge gap behind and the ball races to the fence. A rare expensive over from Jadeja!
SIX! This has been connected! Lands it around off, turning away, Shadab kneels down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Shadab dances down, Jadeja spears it in. The leggie looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Flatter delivery, sliding in, dabbed to point.

Run out chance! Pitched outside off, Khan dabs it in the gap between point and covers and takes off for a single but is sent back. Jadhav from covers, runs to his left and has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. The batsmen then run off an overthrow.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Khan taps it to cover-point.
Length delivery outside off, steered to point.
Shadab Khan comes out to bat.

OUT! Golden duck for Imad Wasim! This is poor cricket from the Pakistani all-rounder. With his side in trouble, he hit the first delivery he faced, straight to the fielder. On a back of a length and angling away, Imad stays tall and hits it on the up. Doesn't keep it along the ground and it's straight at the throat of Jadhav at short cover, who takes a good, sharp catch. Another one down for Pakistan. 154 needed off 81 balls.
Length delivery, angling in, tucked towards short fine leg for a single.
Angling down leg, tickled to short fine leg.
Arm ball, sliding in, punched through covers for a single.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Full around leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Imad Wasim strides out to bat.

OUT! Hafeez holes out! Arm ball, sliding in, Hafeez gets down on one knee and looks to slog sweep but he too gets a top edge like Ali. The ball travels towards deep mid-wicket. Bhuvneshwar runs to his left and this time completes the catch. Pakistan have half of their side back in the hut. Jadeja is on fire right now. He's been involved in the last 4 wickets.
Beaten! Flatter delivery outside off, Hafeez tries to cut it but misses it completely. Good delivery, this!
Full outside off, pushed to covers.
Length delivery outside off, dabbed to point.
Wide! Angling down leg, Ahmed leaves it and a wide is signaled.
Guided to third man for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On a length and angling in, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.

Hesitation in between! Pitched on a length outside off, Hafeez dabs it behind point and takes off for the second but halts in between after another miscommunication. However, they then run through as the throw at the bowler's end is not a strong one. The cover fielder collects the ball and lobs it over the stumps at bowler's end. In the end, a brace is completed.
On a length and angling in, Hafeez gets across and tucks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Hardik Pandya returns for a bowl.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Darted in on middle, Ahmed looks to sweep it but misses and gets rapped on the pads.
Fired in around middle and off, defended off the front foot.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total. Hafeez wants second but is sent back.
Sliding in around leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Innovative! Slanting down leg, Ahmed kneels down and paddle sweeps it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Short ball, angling in, pulled to the right of Bumrah at fine leg. A brace is taken.
A touch ahead of length outside off, Hafeez looks to cut but misses as it's not short enough.
On a length and outside off, punched through point for a single.
Sarfraz Ahmed is the new man in. Pakistan need 175 in 105 balls.

OUT! Bull's eye from Jadeja! Don't ever mess with his throwing arm and especially in that region. Shorter length delivery outside off, Malik stays back, dabs it behind point and takes off for a quick single. Hafeez sends him back. Jadeja at backward point, rushes to the ball, picks it and has a throw at the keeper's end in a flash. Hits the bottom of the leg stump and catches Malik short by miles. This is something really, really special from the Indian all-rounder. Big blow for Pakistan and they are now in huge trouble.
Cutter on a shorter side, Hafeez drags his pull off the inner half in behind square on the leg side for a single.
A touch ahead of length outside off, Hafeez looks to play it with a straight bat but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Umesh Yadav is back on!
Served outside off, dabbed to short third man.
The ball has been replaced as the ball got lost in the sightscreen!

SIX! Into the stands! Malik dances down the track. Jadeja sees that and drags his length back. Malik is not near the pitch of the ball but still goes through with his lofted shot over the bowler's head. Connects it well and the ball sails over ropes for a maximum!
Arm ball, sliding in, Malik looks to cut but there's no room. Ends up placing it to point.
Once again Hafeez dances down, Jadeja darts it in. The batsman can only dig it out through mid off for a single.

FOUR! Dancing shoes are on! Fired in full outside off, Hafeez gets to the pitch of the ball and goes inside out over extra cover. Beats the long off fielder and the ball crosses the ropes. Hafeez getting a move on now!
Flatter delivery outside off, cut to point.
A touch ahead of length outside off, Hafeez flashes his bat at it, gets an outside edge to third man for a single.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. One run added to the total.

FOUR! Fine this time! Pandya gets his line wrong, angles it down the leg side. Malik just helps it on its way and Yadav in the deep can't stop it from reaching the fine leg fence. So, back-to-back boundaries for Pakistan!
FOUR! Nice shot to get off the mark! It's full outside off, Malik extends his arms and drives it square of the wicket on the off side for a boundary.
Banged in short, Malik gets out of the way at the last moment. Good delivery, this!
Length delivery, angling in, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.

Hesitation in the middle! Jadeja slides it in from around off, Malik looks to tap it in covers and take off for a single but is sent back by his partner. Malik turns and makes it in with a dive. Had there been a direct hit, it would have been close.
Shoaib Malik comes out to bat. Pakistan need 198 more runs to win.

OUT! Jadeja gets his man! Soon after reaching his half century, Ali departs. Jadeja bowls a flatter arm ball. Ali gets down on one knee and looks to slog sweep but gets a top edge. The ball flies over backward square leg. Hardik Pandya at deep square leg, runs to his right and pouches it with ease near the ropes. The set man departs and the Indians are joyous.
Hafeez kneels down and sweeps it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
10th ODI fifty for Azhar Ali.
Ali raises his bat! Shorter in length, punched towards long on for a single. With that, he completes a fifty. It has been a good knock from him so far. Now, he has to build on it.
Azhar steps down the track, Jadeja fires it in and the Pakistan opener can only push it back to the bowler.
Served around middle and leg, worked through backward square leg for a single.
Slants it on a length on off, worked through mid on for a single.
Back of a length on off, Hafeez dabs it down the wicket with an open face of the bat.
Hurls it on a good length on the stumps, Hafeez looks to pull it through but does not get it off the middle and the ball dies down on the wicket.
Good length outside off, Hafeez turns it towards mid-wicket.
Slants it on a length, Hafeez wants to turn it through the leg side but is hurried by the pace.
Angles it on a good length on off, Hafeez turns it towards short mid-wicket.
Too full on middle, Azhar comes down to clip it through but gets an inside edge towards the off side.
Flatter on middle, Ali keeps it out at the last moment.
Angles it on the stumps, Ali looks to sweep it through but is hit on his pads. There is an appeal for an lbw but not given. No review and rightly so, Ali had gloved it.
Flatter on middle, Ali comes down and turns it towards mid-wicket.
Floats it outside off, pushed towards covers. There is a fumble which allows a single. The captain was the man in question there. Jadeja got to the ball quickly going to his left.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Drops it short, Hafeez does not miss out and pulls it through long leg for a boundary.
Drags it through mid-wicket for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, Hafeez looks to pull it through but is beaten all ends up. Hardik has bowled a few of those today.
Slants it on the stumps, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Angles it on off, Ali looks to defend but gets a bottom edge onto his pads, the ball dies down the wicket.
Fuller outside off, Hafeez looks to drive but gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket for a single.
Angles it on a good length, Hafeez defends it watchfully.
Flatter on the stumps, Azhar looks to turn it through the leg side but finds the short fine leg fielder. He actually got an inside edge there.
Pushed through mid off for a single.
Top edge! Ali looks to sweep but gets a top edge on the bounce to short fine leg. A single taken.
Bowls it flatter on the stumps, Ali looks to turn it through but is struck on the pads again. A loud appeal but no review from India.
Fires it on the stumps, Ali fails to clip it through coming down the wicket and is hit on the pads.
In the air but safe! Lands it outside off, Hafeez punches it wide of Virat Kohli at short cover for a single.
Ravindra Jadeja comes on for a bowl.

FOUR! Nicely done! Shorter in length, Ali looks to ramp it to third man. There is a fielder there, who was brought finer but this time he gets it wide of him. Yuvraj covers good ground, going to his right. He looks to stop it but the ball still trickles over the fence.
WIDE! Shorter in length on the stumps, Ali looks to hook it but fails to do so. The umpire signals it a wide for height. Good one that though.
Shorter in length, pulled to fine leg for a single.
Driven through covers for a single.
Slants it full and outside off, Hafeez guides it towards point for a single.
Angles it on back of a length just outside off, Hafeez pushes it to covers from his crease.
Ali comes forward and guides it through point for a single.
Good length just outside off, left alone by the batsman. Dhoni now fumbles behind the wickets.
Fuller outside off, Hafeez comes forward and drives it through covers for a brace. Two runs taken.
Good length on the stumps, Hafeez looks to clip it through but gets hit on his pads.
Good length outside off, glided down to third man for a single.
Fuller outside off, mistimed drive from Azhar to mid off.
Shorter in length outside off, Ali looks to cut it but the ball seams away at the last moment.
Lands it outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Azhar gets forward and pushes it to covers.
Too full from Pandya, Ali hits it over him. Mid off fielder cuts it off.

Dropped! Angles it on a length, Ali comes down to go over mid off but the bat turns in his hands. Kumar comes in from long on, gets two hands to it but does not hold onto the chance. India have not fielded well at all. He covered good ground but should have taken the catch. Two runs taken.
Angles it outside off, pushed towards covers by the batsman.
Fuller outside off, driven off the front foot to backward point.
Hardik Pandya called on for a bowl.
Shorter length outside off, Hafeez looks to pull it through but is beaten.
Fuller outside off, driven towards mid off by Hafeez. They do not take Kohli on.
Hafeez comes forward and guides it towards point from his crease.
Angles it on a length just outside off, comes in, Hafeez lets it go through but that was not far from the stumps.
Mohammad Hafeez is the new man in.

OUT! Umesh strikes! Short again, just outside off, Azam looks to cut it hard again but finds Jadeja at backward point. A very good catch that, given the fielding standards so far in the game. Pakistan would have hoped for more from their talented batsman.
FOUR! India not fielding well at the moment. Shorter outside off, cut behind point by Babar. Kedar Jadhav in the deep overruns and allows the ball to go through him for a boundary.
Ali seems to have hurt his leg with the dive in the previous over. He is getting his right leg tapped.

Another chance gone! Outside off on a length, Azam looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards the off side and Ali calls him through for a single. Bumrah gets to the ball and looks to run out Azhar at the striker's end but misses. Had he hit, Ali would have been a goner.
Fumble! Fuller in length just around off, Azam clips it through mid-wicket. Kumar allows the ball to go through him and concedes a couple of runs.
Hurls it just outside off, defended watchfully.
Length ball just outside off, Azhar clips it towards mid on for a single.
Good length outside off, Babar gets off the mark with a dab to third man. Yuvraj did well at third man to keep them to a single.
Slants it on the stumps, Ali looks to clip but gets it off his pads towards square leg for a single. Leg bye signaled.
Fuller outside off, driven crisply to mid off. A maiden from Umesh.
Good length outside off, Azam punches it towards covers from his crease.
Fuller in length, driven back to the bowler. Umesh leaps in his follow through and stops the ball. Good work, there.
Hurls it outside off, Babar gets behind the line and defends it. Screams no to his partner.
Good length just outside off, Azam looks to defend but is beaten by the away movement.
Slants it on the stumps, Azam walks across and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Umesh Yadav called back on for a bowl.
Fuller outside off, hit towards mid off by the batsman. Good comeback from Bumrah after the boundary first ball. Pakistan need 238 more in 31 overs.
Good length just outside off, Ali looks to clip it through but gets it off the leading edge towards covers.
Fuller but slower in pace, Ali comes forward and defends it late. Didn't pick the slower one early.
Azhar gets in line and clips it towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Good length outside off, Ali taps it towards point.
FOUR! Hit away! Shorter length outside off, Azhar Ali gets under it and ramps it over the keeper for a boundary. Bumrah has struggled with his lengths here. 50 up for Pakistan.
Babar Azam walks out to bat.

OUT! First strike for India! Angles it on a good length, Shehzad looks to clip but is hit on his pads. The players go up in an appeal and the umpire rules it in favour of the bowler. Shehzad comes over to have a chat with his partner but they decide against the review. Was it outside the line or going over the stumps? Let's wait for the Ball Tracker. It shows three reds and hence, it was a good decision.
Edged! Azhar looks to work one through the leg side but gets a leading edge wide of point for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful! Full and outside off, Ali presents the full face of the bat and gets it past a diving mid off for a boundary.
Short outside off, dabbed towards third man for a single.
Turns it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Gets it square of the wicket behind point for a brace.
Powerplay 2 signaled. Maximum of 4 players can be allowed outside the circle now.

Direct hit and Ali would have been a goner! Angles it on a length, Azhar taps it to covers for a single. Hardik Pandya gets to the ball and looks to score a direct hit at the bowler's end but misses. Ali had given up after colliding with the bowler. Could Pandya have taken more time to hit the stumps?
FOUR! Up and over! Fuller and outside off, Ali gets under it and launches it over the mid on fielder for a boundary.
Two men at point now.
Good length outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Shehzad gets in line and defends it.
Fuller outside off, hit towards point again.
Angles in a back of a length delivery just outside off, Shehzad angles it towards point from his crease.
Lands it on a good length, just outside off, punched towards the leg side.
Good length outside off, Ali looks to walk across and nudge it through the leg side but is beaten by the extra bounce. Lot of oohs and aahs followed.
Good length outside off, punched on the up through covers for a couple of runs.
Back of a length outside off, guided behind point for a single. Jadeja loses his pant in the process and gets up sheepishly.
Hurls it outside off, hit towards Dhawan at cover-point. He fumbles and allows a single.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed behind point for a single.
FOUR! Crashed! Short and wide outside off, Ali throws the kitchen sink at it and gets it between point and backward point for a boundary.
Angles it on a length, Ali mistimes his punch back down the wicket. The bowler looks to get a hand to it and stop but fails to do that. The mid on fielder cuts it off.
Lands it outside off on a length, Ali aims to spank it through covers but is beaten all ends up.
Fuller outside off, Ali punches it nicely towards mid off.
Short and outside off, Shehzad guides it to down to point for a single.
Starts off with a back of a length delivery outside off, Shehzad defends it watchfully.
Jasprit Bumrah is the first change.
Ali gets in line and pushes it towards mid on from his crease.

4 bowlers can bowl 8 overs, 1 bowler can bowl 9 overs. Powerplay 1 (1-8), Powerplay 2 (9-33), Powerplay 3 (34-41). That is for the updated playing conditions. The players are back out in the middle. Azhar Ali and Ahmed Shehzad to continue batting. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to complete his over.

Update 1645 local time - The rain has stopped. The covers are coming off. Play to resume at 1655 local time. The target for Pakistan is 289 in 41 overs. So, 267 runs needed from 36.1 overs. We have lost seven overs for the break.

Update 1622 local time - The drizzle is back now and the players are going off the field. Pakistan need 302 more runs in 43.1 overs (By DLS method). Let's hope the rain clears soon and we get back on the field.
Angles it around off, Ali defends it watchfully.
It has started to drizzle now.

Slants it on the stumps, Shehzad looks to clip it through but is beaten and hit on the pads. There is an appeal for an lbw but the umpire stays mum. Kohli inquires about it to Dhoni who refuses the option of the review.
Angles it on the stumps, Shehzad digs it out from his crease.
Back of a length outside off, Shehzad tries to tap and run on the off side but fails to do so.

Swing! Fuller outside off, Shehzad looks to drive it through the off side but gets beaten all ends up.
FOUR! Powered away! Shorter in length on the stumps, Ali hooks it down to the backward square leg fence. This is a sedate start for Pakistan.
Edged! Good length just outside off, Ali looks to clear England but misses. The ball goes off the body towards first slip.
Shehzad turns it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter outside off, Ali chops it through backward point for a single.
Second slip goes out.
Ali punches this one towards mid off from his crease.
Beaten! Hurls it just outside off on a good length, Ali looks to play at it but is beaten all ends up.
Hurls it outside off, left alone by Shehzad. Dhoni cannot collect it and uses his pads to stop the ball.
Fuller in length just outside off, defended watchfully.
Fuller on the pads, Ali turns it through square leg. Bumrah gets across from the deep and slides to his left to stop the ball. A run saved for his side.
Good length outside off, swinging away, Shehzad gets it down to third man for a single.
Angles it on a length, Ali pushes it towards mid on and takes a single. Yuvraj is slow to take off and allows the run.
Good length outside off, Ali punches it towards covers from his crease.
Shorter in length, Ali pulls it down to fine leg for a run, despite the fumble by Kumar in the deep.
Bowls it a touch fuller, just outside off, Ali defends it with his bat and pad together. The inside edge saved him.
Good length just around off, worked wide of mid on for a single.
Fuller in length on the stumps, Shehzad turns it towards mid on from his crease.
FOUR! Flashed! Shorter outside off, Shehzad goes after the width and gets it past point for a boundary.
Good length just around off, Shehzad defends it from his crease.
Umesh Yadav to bowl from the other end with the second new ball. Two slips in place for him as well.
Length delivery outside off, left alone.
On a length outside off, moves away with slight extra bounce. Ali defends it in covers.

Length delivery, angling in, tucked to mid-wicket.
Wide! Back of a length delivery outside off, Ali looks to cut it but misses. It's too wide and the umpire spreads his arms to signal a wide.
Pitched outside off, shaping away a touch. Ali leaves it alone.

We are back for the chase. Azhar Ali to open with Ahmed Shehzad. Pakistan will need a healthy partnership first up to chase this huge total down. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to start the proceedings with the first new ball. A couple of slips in place. Here we go...
